en: Welcome to the cups! Eight battles in a row under a cup's rules, and a prize the first time you win it.
Would you like to enter a cup?
The Crest Cup: three Pokémon of levels 50 to 55, no more than 155 levels together.
The Sprout Cup: three Pokémon at level 5 that are the first of their line and can still evolve.
The Spark Cup: three Pokémon of levels 15 to 20, no more than 50 levels together.
The Pebble Cup: three Pokémon of levels 25 to 30, no taller than 2 m and no heavier than 20 kg, no more than 80 levels together.
The Summit Cup: three Pokémon of any level. Anything goes, but the strongest of the Frontier's rules.
Will you bring your own Pokémon, or borrow ours?
Please choose the three you'll enter.
Here are three of ours, ready for this cup. Look after them!
Your first opponent is waiting on the field. Good luck!
Your Pokémon are whole again. Ready for the next battle?
You retire from the cup. Come back and try it from the start whenever you like.
Eight in a row! You've won the cup!
{player} received the {item} for winning the cup for the first time!
Congratulations. Your name is on the stadium's board.
That's the end of your cup. Every Trainer loses one sometimes. Try again!
I'm sorry, those three don't meet the cup's rules: their levels, their total, their size or their line.
They must also be of three different species, holding different items.
Each cup has its own rules: how high your Pokémon's levels may be, their total, their size or how far they've evolved.
Your own Pokémon battle as they are, at their own levels. Rentals come at the cup's highest level.
Win eight battles in a row to win the cup. Lose once, and the cup starts over.
The cups are always open. Come back whenever you're ready.
This is the Leaders' round: every Gym Leader of a region, then its Elite Four and its Champion, one after another.
Everyone battles at level 100, your three and theirs.
Which region's round will you take on?
That region's round opens once you've entered its Hall of Fame.
Please choose the three you'll enter. They'll battle at level 100 for the round.
Your Pokémon are whole again. On to the next match?
You retire from the round. Come back and start it again whenever you like.
You've beaten the whole round! Every Leader, the Elite Four and the Champion. What a run!
The round ends here. Rest up, and take it on again from the first Leader.
The Leaders will be here. Come back whenever you're ready.
The sparring room! Choose a type, enter three of it, and spar against Trainers who use it too, as long as you can.
Which type will you spar with?
Which type will you spar with?
Which type will you spar with?
Which type will you spar with?
Your best in this room is {number} in a row.
You need three Pokémon that can take part, of different species and holding different items.
Please choose the three you'll enter. All three must be of the room's type.
Your Pokémon are whole again. Keep going?
A fine streak. It's on the room's record.
That's the streak over. Train hard and come back!
All three must be of the room's type. Choose again when you have three.
Those three must be of different species, holding different items.
Come back when you feel like a workout.
